verdict.rationale: Navan's developer API covers a substantial slice of the expense domain (transactions, custom fields, receipts, webhooks) and an MCP server lets AI assistants query spend/policy data, but there's no evidence of API/MCP coverage for travel booking, Navan Edge concierge actions, or rewards management — core UI capabilities that appear to remain UI-only or human-agent-mediated. missing for 10: API/MCP parity for travel booking and itinerary changes, Navan Edge concierge actions via API, rewards/loyalty management via API.
